title: nilchela values
description: Rejects unknown or malformed keys before render. That is the guard a chart which exposes a dependency's schema cannot have: there, an unrecognised key is silently ignored by the renderer.

common.description: SPIKE FIX: Helm injects the library dependency's values under this key before schema validation. It is NOT part of the user surface — the translation never reads it. Present only so additionalProperties:false does not reject Helm's own bookkeeping.

mise.description: The mise.toml the image consumes, keyed as that file is written: `tools` is its [tools] table, `env` its [env] table. Both are deployment policy — the chart pins no toolchain, so it can neither choose versions nor know which variables that toolchain needs.

tools.description: mise [tools] table. Values are version strings, or a map of tool options (rendered as a TOML sub-table).

env.description: mise [env] table: toolchain runtime environment (cache redirection, dist mirrors), applied by the image's `mise exec` entrypoint.

volumes.description: Two sections, because they answer two different questions. `required` is the image's contract — the three volumes it expects at /tools, /cache and /zeroclaw-data — so the chart owns those paths and `path` is refused there; each is a claim by default, and `type: emptyDir` trades the claim for a pod-local directory. `extra` is what the deployer adds, where the key IS the mount path. Both sections are optional: values.yaml supplies every key below, so a values file names only what it changes.

required.description: The image's three volumes. A closed set: `path` is not accepted, because the chart places it. `type` chooses what backs the path — a claim or an emptyDir — and nothing else about the mount is yours to move.

extra.description: Volumes the deployer adds. The key is the mount path (`media` mounts at /media); `path` overrides it for a nested route. Mounting machinery (globalMounts/advancedMounts) is deliberately not exposed — the chart places every mount. `nfs` and `custom` are not exposed: `nfs` needs a field the library also calls `path`, and `custom` is the raw passthrough this surface exists to replace.

probes.description: Liveness/readiness/startup probes. Readiness and liveness ship on, startup off; each is enabled individually and all three share one port default.

probe.description: One probe. `spec` merges over the derived probe, so it takes the full k8s Probe shape (initialDelaySeconds, periodSeconds, timeoutSeconds, failureThreshold, successThreshold, terminationGracePeriodSeconds).

requiredVolume.description: One of the image's three volumes. `type` is `persistentVolumeClaim` (default) or `emptyDir`. The claim fields and the emptyDir fields are mutually exclusive, and the translation layer fails on the contradiction naming the key and the field, rather than accept a value nothing reads.

extraVolume.description: One extra volume. `type` names the kind of source — exactly one kind per entry, which is what makes 'a volume nothing mounts' and 'two sources under one name' unexpressible rather than merely discouraged.

defaultMode.description: Octal file mode as a string, e.g. "0444". Emitted unquoted so YAML parses it as a number — k8s rejects a quoted mode.
